roadmapPage.metaTitle: FinTech roadmap — a practical guide from first principles to architecture
roadmapPage.metaDescription: A field-style guide to money flows, systems architecture, and regulatory compliance—phases, practical outcomes, topics with official references. For beginners, engineers building payment systems, and PMs planning a launch.
roadmapPage.title: The FinTech roadmap
roadmapPage.subtitle: It is more than code—it is where money movement, systems architecture, and regulatory compliance meet. I designed this path to be your practical guide—whether you are starting from scratch, an engineer building payment systems, or a product manager planning a launch.
roadmapPage.journeyHeading: How do you get the most from the roadmap?
roadmapPage.journeyStep1: Sequence first: follow the order to build a complete mental model of the field.
roadmapPage.journeyStep2: Focus next: return and go deeper in the parts that intersect with your role or project.
roadmapPage.journeyStep3: Hands-on application: connect concepts to official sources and market reality with the mindset of building a real product.
roadmapPage.outcomesHeading: After this phase you will be able to
roadmapPage.topicsSub: Each block explains the idea in plain language. Expand “References” for articles, regulators, and courses—verify anything critical before you rely on it in production.
roadmapPage.resourcesHint: External sites open in a new tab. Official sources (central banks, FATF, schemes) beat random blogs for compliance questions.
roadmapPage.disclaimerBody: This roadmap distils field experience into a knowledge guide. It is not a substitute for legal advice or formal academic programmes. FinTech and its regulatory context change quickly; always verify against primary sources and obtain qualified professional counsel before production decisions or taking a product to market.
roadmapPage.tocHint: Jump to a section while you scroll.
roadmapPage.mobilePathHint: Tap a step to jump — or scroll and use the buttons at the end of each section.
